title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Cardholder Tenure and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Deductible
content:
Long-standing Ridgeline Consumer Credit cardholders pay a lower Ridgeline Tool Rental damage deductible.

Cardholder tenure lowers the deductible: when the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account was opened at least 96 whole calendar months before the day the deductible is billed, the deductible is multiplied by 0.90; at least 36 but fewer than 96 whole calendar months before, by 0.95; fewer than 36 whole calendar months before, or with no such account, it is unchanged.

Tenure runs from the opening date on the Ridgeline Consumer Credit account record to the day the deductible is billed, in whole calendar months.

The multiplier acts on the damage deductible before the deductible is held to the repair cost assessed at the return inspection, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Tenure table

| Whole calendar months from opening to the billing day | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 0.90 |
| 36 to 95 | 0.95 |
| fewer than 36 | 1 (unchanged) |
| no Ridgeline Consumer Credit account | 1 (unchanged) |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical deductible billed on 3 November 2026)

| Account opened | Whole calendar months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 3 November 2018 | 96 | 0.90 |
| 4 November 2018 | 95 | 0.95 |
| 3 November 2023 | 36 | 0.95 |
| 4 November 2023 | 35 | 1 |
